notes.title: [Final Update] New Ending, Open World & System Optimizations Now Live!
notes.content:
[p]Dear Detective Adventurers, thank you for your patience! This final update brings a complete story closure, a wealth of new content, and a full range of gameplay enhancements—inviting you to embark on an even more immersive detective journey![/p][h2][b]🌟 Key Update Content[/b][/h2][olist][*][p][b]Chapter 4 (Final Chapter) Launches, Concluding the Story[/b]
The highly anticipated Chapter 4 is now officially available, marking the perfect end to the entire storyline! All foreshadowing and mysteries will be revealed here, taking you through a thrilling and emotional final ending.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chapters 1-3 Revamped, with Enhanced Story Details[/b]
To enrich the story’s depth, we’ve added a large number of [b]additional filmed video clips[/b] to Chapters 1-3. Some key plot sections have also been optimized and adjusted—even players who’ve already experienced the early content will gain a fresh perspective on the story.[/p][/*][*][p][b]"Open World" Exploration Unlocked, with Diverse New Content[/b]
A brand-new massive open exploration area is now available! It includes:[/p][list][*][p]Multiple exclusive [b]new story videos[/b] that expand the game’s worldview;[/p][/*][*][p]Unique [b]special story comics[/b] that supplement character backgrounds and hidden side storylines.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Protagonist Attribute System Goes Live, Boosting Detective Efficiency[/b]
The "Protagonist Attribute System" has been added to the Open World. By upgrading attributes (such as Observation, Deduction, etc.), you can unlock benefits like key clue hints and reduced puzzle-solving time during investigations—customizing your unique detective style.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievement System Unlocked, with Fun Challenge Goals[/b]
A rich achievement system has been added, covering multiple categories including story progression, exploration discoveries, and skill-based operations. Complete challenges to unlock exclusive achievement badges and record your highlight moments as a detective.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Artistic Performance Optimized, for Greater Immersion[/b]
Comprehensive optimizations have been made to in-game scene details, character animations, and lighting effects—enhancing visual refinement and impact. Every exploration will now feel even more immersive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG Fixes for Smoother Gameplay[/b]
We’ve fixed several issues reported by players, optimized game stability and control responsiveness, and ensured a seamless detective experience with no interruptions.[/p][/*][/olist][h2][b]⚠️ Important Notice[/b][/h2][p]Due to the extensive feature iterations and content restructuring in this update, [b]existing save files are incompatible with the new version’s underlying architecture[/b]. After updating, old save files may suffer from data corruption and fail to load normally.[/p][p]
[/p][p]For the best possible gameplay experience, we recommend that all players start a new game after updating—allowing you to fully experience the final chapter’s story and the charm of the new systems. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your understanding and support![/p][p]
[/p][p]Wishing all detectives a wonderful and surprising journey in the brand-new detective world![/p]

notes.title: "Mist Judgment" official version update preview
notes.content: [p]After several months, we're thrilled to announce that "Mist Judgment" is now officially complete! The team is currently working diligently on the final finishing touches, and we'll be releasing it to you soon.[/p][p]During development and testing, we received a wealth of valuable feedback from players. We carefully reviewed and considered all your suggestions, from UI design and performance to story content, and made every effort to make adjustments based on practical considerations, striving to provide you with the most immersive story experience possible.[/p][p]This game may not be perfect, but it embodies the dedication and passion of the entire team. We've also accumulated valuable experience and lessons, and these growth will be reflected and refined in future projects.[/p][p]Finally, regarding the official launch date everyone is most concerned about—stay tuned: September 13, 2025 (UTC+08:00 Beijing).[/p][p]Thank you all for your patience and continued support. May you all soon be able to dispel the fog in the world of "Mist Judgment."[/p]

notes.title: Chapter 3 update instructions
notes.content:
--------Updated content--------
1. The story of Chapter 3 has been updated
2. The performance of some UIs has been optimized
3. Several bugs have been fixed
4. A "Chapter Selection" option has been added to the menu interface. Players who have passed the prologue can select any unlocked chapter to enter
--------Special Note--------
After this update, we have completed the game content of the first three chapters of the EA version, but it must be noted that the current content does not represent the final quality of the game. In fact, we will make major adjustments to the existing updated content, including the plot. The focus of our update is: 
1. Complete the production of the fourth chapter and the main plot, explain the complete world view of the whole story, and provide more ending experiences;
2. There are still many unreasonable plot contents in the first three chapters. We are coordinating with the relevant actors to reshoot. After the update, the existing plot will be smoother, more complete and more exciting;
3. Launch the big world exploration function, and improve the game numerical system and trial strategy gameplay;
4. Upgrade the existing art and music. In the final version, a large amount of interactive text and pictures will be replaced by videos.

The full version of the game will be available to you before the end of August. We will continue to polish the final presentation quality of the game. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Updated June 16
notes.content: Added a reminder after entering the game - after the update, the old archive data will be partially damaged. Players can quickly skip the existing plot through the story line part of the game if necessary.

notes.title: Chapter 2 Update Instructions
notes.content:
--------Updated content--------
1. The story of the second chapter has been updated.
2. Updated multiple interaction methods to make your reasoning journey more interactive.
3. Fixed several bugs.
--------Special note--------
1. We are still in the EA stage, and the updated content will be further modified and improved in the future development.
2. In response to the expectations of players, we have greatly accelerated the development progress. The content of the third chapter is expected to meet players at the end of June, so stay tuned.
